tasks.label: 1. Start Database
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db  && docker network connect safequestai_default $(hostname) || true

tasks.label: 2. Start Backend
tasks.command: until [ -f /tmp/.devcontainer_ready ] ; do echo "Waiting for devcontainer postCreateCommand setup to finish..."; sleep 2; done; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --reload --port 8000 --env-file ../.env

tasks.label: 3. Start Frontend
tasks.command: until [ -f /tmp/.devcontainer_ready ] ; do echo "Waiting for devcontainer postCreateCommand setup to finish..."; sleep 2; done; npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
